_note: The addresses of a local build. Override them with the environment variables OCTACHROME_SITE_URL and OCTACHROME_REPO_URL (the Pages workflow does, from the repository it runs in). scripts/check-site.py warns if they are placeholders.
name: Octachrome
tagline: A groovebox you play with a Maschine MK3
description: Octachrome is a standalone groovebox in Rust for the Raspberry Pi, played with a Native Instruments Maschine MK3: polymetric steps, a chord Brain, eight instruments, a sampler, and every screen and light of the MK3.
